reactions.description: NanG5 represents a glycosyltransferase that attaches the deoxysugar moiety (4-O-methyl-L-rhodinose) to the nanchangmycin aglycone at C-19

ACP-bound nanchangmycin aglycone is glycosylated with 4-O-methyl-L-rhodinose at the C-19 hydroxyl under the control of NanG5, before final hydrolytic release of nanchangmycin by the NanE thioesterase.

evidenceCode: Inference from genomic data and chemical structure
